before: The pretraining scripts take eccDNA coordinates from eccDNA Atlas (human, chicken, mouse) and CircleBase (human) and extract the sequences from the hg19, hg38, galGal4 and mm10 reference genomes.
after: The pretraining scripts take eccDNA coordinates from eccDNA Atlas (human, chicken, mouse) and CircleBase (human) and extract the sequences from the hg19, galGal4 and mm10 reference genomes; the download script also fetches hg38.
why: extract_sequences.py opens only hg19, galGal4 and mm10; download_datasets.py also downloads hg38. Added quotes for the Fasta calls and the hg38 URL.

before: Pretrained and task-specific fine-tuned weights, plus the task datasets, are openly available under Apache-2.0.
after: Pretrained and task-specific fine-tuned weights, plus the task datasets, are on Hugging Face; all eight model repositories are tagged Apache-2.0. The licence of the datasets is not stated in the sources read.
why: hf-org-models.json tags all eight models apache-2.0, but no saved file gives a licence for the datasets. Added @hf-org-models as a source with a quote.

before: Weights and datasets: https://huggingface.co/eccDNAMamba, not gated.
after: Weights and datasets: https://huggingface.co/eccDNAMamba. eccDNAMamba-1M and eccDNAMamba_1M_cancer_eccdna_prediction_ultra_long are not gated; gating of the other repositories was not checked.
why: Only hf-api.json (eccDNAMamba-1M) and hf-api-ultra-long.json carry "gated":false; the organisation listing has no gated field. The reviewer's fix named only eccDNAMamba-1M, but hf-api-ultra-long.json also supports the ultra-long model, so it is included and cited.
